breakout.note: Closest to the 252-session closing high, with the 10-day average daily range as tightness; readings only

unusual_volume.note: Volume today vs its own 50-session average (names trading at least $2M a day)

correlation_web.note: Daily-close return correlation over the last 120 sessions among the 168 names with aligned history; clusters join names linked by correlation of at least 0.85. A reading of what moved together, not a forecast.

gap_fill.note: Opening gaps of 0.5% or more on liquid names (at least $2M a day) over the last 250 sessions: the share that traded back to the prior close the same session. Daily bars only, so it cannot say when in the day the fill came.

notes: The engine reads each name's own completed daily bars (about two years) and the weekly context; nothing is fetched for it.
A stance is the engine's net of its evidence kinds, a description of what the chart shows, never an instruction to buy or sell.
The desk's own pre-registered studies found no proven edge in chart patterns or candlesticks after costs; they are shown as a technician's read.
